Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20072
⌈If
• StbM_GetRxFreshness returns non-recoverable error code (e.g., E_NOT_OK)
Ethernet

sage,
the ICV verification of received Follow_Up message is considered to be failed, and the
Time Slave shall :
• stop the ICV verification (refer to chapter "ICV Verification". see link i
